mainEntity.name: What kind of materials are used for deck structural repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: For deck structural repairs, common materials include pressure-treated lumber for its resistance to rot and insects, which is often used for joists, beams, and posts. Fasteners are typically galvanized or stainless steel for corrosion resistance. In some cases, composite materials or steel components may be used for specific reinforcements, depending on the deck's original construction and the repair needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pressure-treated lumber is common for joists, beams, and posts. Galvanized or stainless steel fasteners are used, and sometimes composite or steel for reinforcement.
